dialogue.origin: （１０時からよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (I look forward to speaking with you from 10:00.)

dialogue.origin: はい、承知いたしました。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員のなおと申します。
dialogue.content: Hello, my name is Nao and I'll be your counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、お願いします
dialogue.content: Hello, nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you, too.

dialogue.origin: 相談に来てくださりありがとうございます。相談にあたって、最初に、年代・性別など教えて頂ける範囲で結構ですので、教えていただければと思います。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in for a consultation. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender, just to the extent you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.origin: 13歳女子です
dialogue.content: I'm a 13-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: お答えいただき、ありがとうございます。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 学校行きたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、こまってるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. This is really troubling for you.

dialogue.origin: 行きたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to go.

dialogue.origin: 行きたくないりゆうとか、お話できますか？
dialogue.content: Would you be able to tell me about the reasons you don't want to go?

dialogue.origin: クラスの子から無視される
dialogue.content: I'm being ignored by the kids in my class.

dialogue.origin: それは、つらい思いしてるんですね。
dialogue.content: That must be really painful for you.

dialogue.origin: なにか思いあたる理由とか、ありましたか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea why that might be happening?

dialogue.origin: ないんです
dialogue.content: No, I don't.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そうなんですね。いつごろからそんな感じなのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. When did this start happening?

dialogue.origin: 新学期始まって割とすぐ
dialogue.content: Pretty soon after the new semester started.

dialogue.origin: そっかー、、そうすると今月はじめくらいからかな？
dialogue.content: I see... so that would be around the beginning of this month?

dialogue.origin: はい、学校行きたくないです
dialogue.content: Yes, I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、とても大切な事なので、一緒に考えましょう。
dialogue.content: I understand. This is very important, so let's think it through together.

dialogue.origin: そのためにもう少し教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: To do that, could you tell me a little more?

dialogue.origin: １３才ということは、中２かな？
dialogue.content: You're 13, so does that mean you're in the second year of junior high?

dialogue.origin: この前まで仲良くしてたのに…
dialogue.content: We were getting along just fine until recently...

dialogue.origin: はい、ごめんなさい、続けてください
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm sorry—please go on.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仲良くしていたのに、、ですね
dialogue.content: So, even though you were getting along...

dialogue.origin: 休み時間もひとりぼっち、行きたくない
dialogue.content: I'm all alone during breaks, too. I don't want to go.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、悲しいよね・・・
dialogue.content: I see, that must be very sad...

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: うん、一緒に考えようね。とても大事なことだから。
dialogue.content: Yes, let's figure this out together. It's very important.

dialogue.origin: 中１までは仲良かったのね。
dialogue.content: You were close through your first year of junior high, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 春休みとかはどうだったのかな？
dialogue.content: How were things over spring break?

dialogue.origin: みんなで、ラインとかして、普通にしてた
dialogue.content: We were all messaging on LINE, and everything was normal.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、普通になかよかったのね。
dialogue.content: Right, so you were getting along as usual.

dialogue.origin: 新学期はじまって、すぐくらいのラインとかはどうだった？
dialogue.content: How were your LINE conversations right after the new semester started?

dialogue.origin: その頃から、話しかけてもスルーされるようになった
dialogue.content: That's when they started ignoring me, even when I tried to talk to them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ・・・つらいよね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... that must be painful.

dialogue.origin: 新学期始まって、何か環境がかわったこととか、なにか変化があったかな？
dialogue.content: After the new semester started, did anything in your environment change, or was there any other kind of change?

dialogue.origin: 思いあたらない
dialogue.content: I can't think of anything.

dialogue.origin: そっか、、どうしてなんだろうね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... I wonder why that could be.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: What should I do?

dialogue.origin: うん、もう少し教えてもらえますか？一緒に考えていきたいので。
dialogue.content: Yes, could you tell me a little more? I want us to think this through together.

dialogue.origin: スルーされることと、他にも何か嫌なこと、辛いこととかありますか？
dialogue.content: Besides being ignored, is there anything else that's upsetting or difficult for you?

dialogue.origin: 話す人がいないから、ひとりで過ごしてる…
dialogue.content: There's no one to talk to, so I'm spending my time alone...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、みんなと仲良く過ごしたいのにね・・・
dialogue.content: I see... and you just want to get along and have fun with everyone, don't you.

dialogue.origin: 行きたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to go.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、学校行きたくなくなっちゃうよね・・・ちなみに、仲良しの友達は、何人くらいいましたか？
dialogue.content: I can understand that. It would make you not want to go to school... By the way, how many close friends did you have?

dialogue.origin: 5人です
dialogue.content: Five.

dialogue.origin: 今はその５人全員、つめたいかんじなの？
dialogue.content: Are all five of them being cold to you now?

dialogue.origin: はい、グループラインも、無視される
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm ignored in the group chat, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ・・・無視される理由がわからないのって、不安だよね。
dialogue.content: I see... It must be unsettling not knowing why you're being ignored.

dialogue.origin: ラインもリアルでも同じ感じなのかな？
dialogue.content: Is it the same on LINE and in person?

dialogue.origin: うん…
dialogue.content: Yeah...

dialogue.origin: そう。だから一人で居るしかない
dialogue.content: Yes. So I have no choice but to be alone.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、楽しいはずの学校生活、もとに戻れるよう、一緒に考えましょう。
dialogue.content: I see. School life should be fun, so let's think together about how we can get things back to the way they were.

dialogue.origin: ５人の友達の中でも、特に仲良しの子っていますか？
dialogue.content: Among those five friends, was there anyone you were particularly close to?

dialogue.origin: 悲しいです
dialogue.content: I'm sad.

dialogue.origin: その子にもLINEしたんだけど、既読スルーされてる
dialogue.content: I messaged her on LINE, too, but she left me on read.

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ、、悲しい思いしちゃってるね・・・ちなみに、今回のこと、誰かに相談とかしたことあるかな？
dialogue.content: I see, that must be so sad for you... By the way, have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.origin: 誰にも言えません。
dialogue.content: I can't tell anyone.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そうなんですね・・・誰にも言えないのは、どんな思いからかな？
dialogue.content: I see... What is it that makes you feel like you can't tell anyone?

dialogue.origin: 親には心配かけたくないし…
dialogue.content: I don't want to worry my parents...

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 知られたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want them to know.

dialogue.origin: そっか、心配かけたくないからね・・・学校の他の友達とかは、どおですか？
dialogue.content: I see, because you don't want to worry them... What about other friends at school?

dialogue.origin: ん～、共通の友達じゃない、普段はあいさつ位しかしない
dialogue.content: Hmm... they aren't mutual friends. We usually just say hello to each other.

dialogue.origin: うん、いろいろ話してくれてありがとう。
dialogue.content: Okay, thank you for sharing so much with me.

dialogue.origin: また楽しく学校いきたいですよね。
dialogue.content: You want to be able to enjoy school again, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのためには、仲良しの５人の友達と、もとのように楽しく過ごせたらいい感じだよね。
dialogue.content: To make that happen, it would be great if you could have fun with your five close friends again, like you did before.

dialogue.origin: 本当はそうなれたらいい
dialogue.content: I really wish it could be like that.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、、スルーされてることは、たまたまとかじゃない感じかな？
dialogue.content: Right. And it doesn't feel like being ignored is just a coincidence, does it?

dialogue.origin: 返信おくれてるとか
dialogue.content: Like maybe they're just late in replying?

dialogue.origin: 結構気の強い子もいるから、なんか、嫌な感じもしてます
dialogue.content: There are some strong-willed girls in the group, so I have a bad feeling about it.

dialogue.origin: そっか、、例えばどんな感じかな？話せる範囲でいいですよ。
dialogue.content: I see. For example, what is it like? You only have to share what you're comfortable with.

dialogue.origin: なんか、一人の子が、「こうだよね」っていうと、なんかみんなそんな空気に流れていくみたいな感じかな…
dialogue.content: Well, it's like if one of the girls says, "This is how it is, right?" everyone else just kind of goes along with that vibe...

dialogue.origin: そうなんだ、、気の強い子に引っぱられてるみたいな感じなのね、そういう空気ってあるよね。
dialogue.content: I see, so it's like they're being led by the strong-willed one. That kind of atmosphere definitely happens.

dialogue.origin: じゃあ、少し話を整理するね。
dialogue.content: Okay, let me summarize what we've talked about.

dialogue.origin: わかんないけど、そんなこともあるかも
dialogue.content: I'm not sure, but that could be part of it.

dialogue.origin: うん、わかった、教えてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.content: Okay, I understand. Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.origin: この１か月くらい前から、仲良し５人からスルー・無視されるようになった。けど、、その原因や理由はわからない。
dialogue.content: For about the last month, your five close friends have started ignoring you. But you don't know the cause or the reason why.

dialogue.origin: 今は学校でも一人で過ごしてて、親とかにも相談しにくい。
dialogue.content: Now you're spending time alone at school, and you find it difficult to talk to your parents about it.

dialogue.origin: また元のように皆で仲良く過ごしたい。
dialogue.content: You want to get along well with everyone again, like you did before.

dialogue.origin: そこで、何ができるかの相談だけど、いいかな？
dialogue.content: So, our goal is to discuss what you can do about this. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい、どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, what should I do?

dialogue.origin: 仲良しグループで時々あることだけど、その中でも特に仲良くする人が時々変わったりして、相手は無視してるつもりはないけど、無視されてるように伝わることがあるのね、
dialogue.content: This sometimes happens in groups of friends, where the specific people they're closest to might change from time to time. They might not intend to ignore you, but it can come across that way.

dialogue.origin: そのような勘違いがないのか、もう一度状況を考えてみるとかも一つと思います。
dialogue.content: One option is to re-evaluate the situation to see if there might be a misunderstanding like that.

dialogue.origin: あとは、特に仲良かった子に、こっそり、どうしたの？と聞いてみるとかはどおかな？
dialogue.content: Another idea is, what about quietly asking the friend you were closest to, "What's going on?"

dialogue.origin: 怖い気がする
dialogue.content: That sounds scary.

dialogue.origin: そっか、、じゃあどんなことならできそうかな？
dialogue.content: I see. Then what might feel doable for you?

dialogue.origin: 勇気があったらできるかもしれない…
dialogue.content: If I had the courage, maybe I could...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そうだよね。少し勇気いる感じね・・・以前のように何もなかったかのようにふるまって、状況が元に戻ることもあったりするけど、、そのへんはどうかな？
dialogue.content: I understand, yes. It takes a little courage... Sometimes, if you just act as if nothing happened, things can go back to normal. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: わかんないけど、どっちにしても、勇気がいりそう
dialogue.content: I'm not sure, but either way, it seems like it would take courage.

dialogue.origin: そっかそっか、以前、小学生のころとかはどうだった？友達との仲直りとか
dialogue.content: I see. What was it like before, say, in elementary school, when it came to making up with friends?

dialogue.origin: こんなにあんまり、考えていなかったかも…
dialogue.content: I don't think I thought about it this much back then...

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、友達とのこと、考えながら付き合わないよね。
dialogue.content: That's true. You don't usually overthink your friendships.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、皆もあまり考えてないってことない？
dialogue.content: Is it possible that the others aren't thinking about it that much either?

dialogue.origin: わかんないから不安…
dialogue.content: I don't know, and that makes me anxious...

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、不安だよね。このまま、不安のまま、毎日を過ごすか、勇気を出して、特に仲良かった１人の子に、聞いてみるか、聞くのがこわかったら、普段通り接してみるとか、どうかな？
dialogue.content: You're right, it's an anxious feeling. So, what do you think about the options? You can continue spending every day feeling anxious, or you can gather your courage and ask the one friend you were closest to. Or, if asking is too scary, you could try interacting with them as you normally would.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね…何か行動しなかったら、変らないですよね…
dialogue.content: You're right... If I don't do something, nothing will change...

dialogue.origin: このままでは変わらない気がするなら、少し行動してみるのも必要かな。
dialogue.content: If you feel like things won't change as they are, it might be necessary to take a small step.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですよね。話していて、そう思いました
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right. Talking with you has made me think so.

dialogue.origin: 勇気いりと思うけど、、頑張ってみようね！
dialogue.content: I know it takes courage, but let's give it a try!

dialogue.origin: はい。聴いてくれて、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you for listening.

dialogue.origin: 楽しい学校生活おくれるといいですね。応援してますね。
dialogue.content: I hope you can have an enjoyable school life again. I’m rooting for you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談に来てくれてありがとう。また、相談きてください。その後の状況とか教えて。それでまた相談しましょう。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. Please feel free to come back again. You can tell me how things are going, and we can talk more then.

dialogue.origin: また、来ていいんですか？　ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Is it okay for me to come back? Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい、またいつでも来てください。待ってますね。
dialogue.content: Yes, please come back anytime. I'll be waiting.

dialogue.origin: はい、今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （本日はお疲れさまでした。時間オーバーし申し訳ございません）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time today. I apologize for going over our time.)

dialogue.origin: （これにて終了させていただきます）
dialogue.content: (This concludes our session.)

dialogue.origin: (こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。失礼します)
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. Goodbye.)

dialogue.origin: （失礼します）
dialogue.content: (Goodbye.)

topic.sub: 友達からの無視による不安と孤立感
